newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids down, trade quiet.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids down, trade quiet.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat bids were mostly lower Monday after a day of lackluster trading, cash sources said.
"We've seen dibs and dabs of business but nothing really big at all," one Montana-based dealer said.
Cash sources said producer selling was slow in typical post-holiday type trading.

Some of the market's weakness was linked to a modest drop in MGE spring wheat futures. March wheat settled down 1-1/2 cents per bushel lower at 3.80. December MGE wheat closed down 1-1/2 cent per bushel at 4.21.
Cash basis levels were slightly lower Monday, but the drop had no effect on wheat movement, dealers noted.
White wheat bids dropped sharply in response to slow export and domestic markets, dealers said..
